name: Camurus AB (publ)
businessSummary: Swedish biopharmaceutical company developing long-acting injectable drug products (Buvidal for opioid dependence; Brixadi royalty; pipeline incl. Oclaiz, CAM2043/SORENTO).

price.note: Conflicts with an earlier 630.00 snapshot (2026-08-20, pre-Q3).

netDebt.note: Gross cash SEK4.4bn; total debt not separately confirmed -- approximate net cash.

peTrailing.note: Q3 EPS not disclosed in sourced content, could not refresh.

peForward.note: FY2026 consensus EPS 14.70 implies ~45x but not treated as a sourced multiple.

pipelineCatalysts.note: Oclaiz PDUFA 2026-12-18; SORENTO Phase 3 readout Q1 2027; first Brixadi USD15m milestone Q4 2026.

recentEvents: Q3 2026: total revenue SEK724m (+28% YoY); Buvidal record sales SEK574m; EBIT SEK322m (+40%), ~44% margin.
9M2026: revenue 1,959m (+8.8%), EBIT 783m (+2.9%) -- EBIT grew slower than revenue across the 9 months.
Guides FY2026 revenue/operating result to upper half of SEK2.6-2.9bn / 0.9-1.2bn ranges.
Redeye (2026-11-10) raised fair value to SEK745 from 670, rating 'Fairly Priced'.
valueTrapFlags: 9-month EBIT growth (+2.9%) lagged revenue growth (+8.8%) despite a strong standalone Q3.
Rich trailing multiples; independent analyst (Redeye) rates it 'Fairly Priced' not a buy.
Concentrated pipeline (Buvidal, Brixadi royalty, binary catalysts) -- outsized single-event risk.
growthQualityNotes: Strong multi-year revenue/EBIT trend since the FY2021 loss, margins expanding to ~39% by FY2025, though 9-month EBIT growth is decelerating relative to revenue.
dataGaps: Q3 2026 EPS not disclosed, so trailing P/E not refreshed.
FCF, net debt detail, refreshed EV/EBITDA/ROE/ROIC not verified.

valuation.method: EPS-based scenario fair value anchored to FY2026 consensus EPS, tempered by an independent analyst's 'Fairly Priced' call

bear.note: 9-month EBIT deceleration (vs revenue) continues, a pipeline catalyst (Oclaiz/SORENTO) disappoints.

base.note: Buvidal keeps compounding, Brixadi royalties ramp, margin growth resumes after the Q3 lull -- roughly matches Redeye's independent 'Fairly Priced' view.

bull.note: Oclaiz approval (PDUFA Dec 2026) and a positive SORENTO Phase 3 readout both land well.

valuation.whyItFits: Genuine multi-year revenue/margin growth from a commercial, cash-generative pipeline (not pre-revenue biotech), net-cash balance sheet, real pending catalysts -- but already priced close to an independent analyst's own fair value.
valuation.growthDrivers: Buvidal international expansion, Brixadi royalty ramp, Oclaiz and SORENTO pipeline catalysts.
valuation.saturation: 9-month EBIT growth (+2.9%) lagging revenue growth (+8.8%) is an early margin-saturation signal to watch at FY2026 close.
valuation.principalRisk: Concentrated pipeline -- a single regulatory or trial disappointment (Oclaiz, SORENTO) would hit the growth thesis directly.
